blinding_guess.why: Two things look questionable but neither is clearly a break at this revision: (1) left/right image_rect in this node come from image_proc/rectify, which publishes the input unchanged when D is empty or D[0]==0 (rectify.cpp:74-77), ignoring the stereo rectification rotation, so a zero-distortion stereo pair would yield unrectified image_rect feeding the disparity nodelet; (2) the disparity image values are shifted by -(cx_l - cx_r) (disparity.cpp:189-193) while min_disparity/max_disparity (disparity.cpp:171-172) are not, so the definition's rule that disparities below min_disparity are invalid does not match the image when cx_l != cx_r. Headers (DisparityImage.header and image.header) are both copied from the left CameraInfo header, which is consistent.

notes: Snapshot is the rosbuild image_pipeline stack (stack version 1.4.0 from the stack CMakeLists; manifest.xml has no version element); the package is snapshot/stereo_image_proc. ros_distro is null, so no release tag was specified for dependency definitions. I checked only the existence (HTTP status) of candidate tags of ros/common_msgs: 1.4.0-1.8.1 returned 404, 1.9.0 was the earliest found, so definitions were fetched at common_msgs 1.9.0 (sensor_msgs/Image, sensor_msgs/RegionOfInterest, stereo_msgs/DisparityImage) and std_msgs 0.5.0 (Header). This tag choice is an assumption, and the definition_id values and field types depend on it. definition_hash.py resolves package names from package.xml, so I wrote minimal package.xml files (name only) next to the fetched msg trees in the session scratchpad; nothing else was fetched. Topic names are declared relative in code ('disparity', side + '/image_rect'); they resolve to /stereo/... only when the node is started in the /stereo namespace (stereo_image_proc.cpp:87-92 warns if started in '/'). declares/references use the verbatim relative names. left/image_rect and right/image_rect are advertised by the image_proc/rectify nodelet (another package, present in the same snapshot) that this package's stereo_image_proc executable loads with the remapping image_rect -> side/image_rect; this package's disparity nodelet then subscribes to them, so they appear in both declares and references. The disparity topic is likewise both provided (disparity nodelet) and consumed internally (point_cloud/point_cloud2 nodelets). The StereoProcessor library (src/libstereo_image_proc/processor.cpp:49-84) also fills DisparityImage image/min_disparity/max_disparity but sets no header; it is not used by the nodelets. ROS 1: QoS recorded null; publishers use queue size 1 and no rate is set. Private params read (not packet elements): queue_size (default 5), approximate_sync (default false), and the dynamic_reconfigure parameters in cfg/Disparity.cfg. min_disparity/max_disparity frame recorded as none (scalar search-range bounds); their units 'pixels' come from the Disparity.cfg parameter descriptions they are copied from. Unit of the disparity image values is not stated explicitly in the definition or code, so it is null.
